correctness.rationale: Every valid outside set has a three-symbol exact local representation. The finite integer potential is reconstructed by relaxation and all 178 inequalities are verified; the full tight digraph is enumerated (three length-eight simple cycles). Boundary potentials give the path bound, an exhaustive length-six check closes the one exception, and initial words plus a closed eight-step insertion prove infinite attainment. A separate native-graph test exhausts 174672 vertex subsets over 12 instances. The proof does not infer infinitude from finite examples.
